title: Du'ā Seeking Refuge from Worries and Malice
arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمٍّ يَحْزُنُنِيْ وَمِنْ فِكْرٍ يُقْلِقُنِيْ وَعِلْمٍ يُتْعِبُنِيْ وَشَخْصٍ يَحْمِلُ خُبْثًا لِيْ
transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min hammin yaḥzununī wa min fikrin yuqliqunī wa ʿilmin yutʿibunī wa shakhṣin yaḥmilu khubthan lī
translation: Oh Allah! I seek your shelter from worries that sadden me, thoughts that make me restless, information that bothers me, and people that intend bad for me.
